clue.text: Natural wear for a bird (fruity thing, mature)

blocks.note: a plum is a fruit
to mature is to age

explanation.surface: A bird dressed in nature's own clothes, with an aside about ripe fruit.
explanation.definitionFit: Feathers are the covering a bird grows rather than puts on, its natural outfit.

clue.text: Shut up, avert gaze – Osborne primarily replaced by leader of campaign

indicators.note: one thing being replaced by another means a letter is swapped out for a new one
primarily points to the first letter of the name it follows
the leader of a word is the letter at its front

blocks.note: to avert your gaze is to look away
the first letter of Osborne, the letter removed
the leader of campaign is its first letter, the letter put in

explanation.surface: A satirical jab at George Osborne, the Conservative Chancellor, looking away while a campaign takes over.
explanation.walkthrough: One O in LOOK AWAY becomes C, giving LOCK AWAY.
explanation.definitionFit: To shut someone up can mean to imprison or confine them, putting them behind a locked door.

clue.text: see 14ac.
At the start, goolies (large) added to lover's allure

indicators.note: the start of a word is its opening letter, so only that is kept

blocks.note: first letter of goolies, British slang for testicles
L is the standard abbreviation for large, as on clothing labels
amour is a love affair or a lover, from French

explanation.surface: A cheeky Private Eye line about a lover's appeal being well endowed.
explanation.definitionFit: Glamour is attractive charm or allure, especially of a showy, enticing kind.

clue.text: Champion internet partner

blocks.note: E- is the prefix for electronic or internet things, as in email
a spouse is a marriage partner

explanation.surface: Someone hailing a winner they met through online dating.
explanation.walkthrough: Champion is a verb here, to support a cause.
explanation.definitionFit: To espouse a cause is to adopt and support it, just as you champion it.

clue.text: see 25dn.

blocks.note: food gone rotten has gone off
the letters to be rearranged

explanation.surface: Johnny Rotten of the Sex Pistols is even worse when he dances.
explanation.walkthrough: Rotten looks like the punk singer's name, but it simply means gone off.
explanation.definitionFit: Something offensive causes disgust or upset, exactly what obnoxious behaviour does.

clue.text: Very newspaper that is supplying weed

blocks.note: so means very, as in so good
FT is the Financial Times
i.e. is the Latin abbreviation id est, that is

explanation.surface: A tabloid exposé of a paper supplying cannabis.
explanation.walkthrough: Weed reads as cannabis, but it is the insult for a feeble person.
explanation.definitionFit: A weed is a weak, spineless person, much like a soft-hearted pushover.

clue.text: Maybe aspiring MP's camp material House cut and rejected

blocks.note: tents are traditionally made of canvas

explanation.surface: A would-be MP's camp is cut down and rejected by the House of Commons.
explanation.walkthrough: House suggests the Commons, but it is a home, cut down to its abbreviation.
explanation.definitionFit: Candidates for Parliament go door to door seeking votes, which is what canvassing is.

clue.text: After short month, a multinational gets turned over by second-mentioned dodgy organization chief

blocks.note: Sep is the abbreviation for September
BP is the oil giant
the latter is the second of two things mentioned

explanation.surface: A corporate scandal story: a multinational overturned by a dodgy boss.
explanation.walkthrough: Sepp Blatter was the long-serving FIFA president ousted amid corruption scandals in 2015; the 11-across clue names his organisation.
explanation.definitionFit: Blatter headed football's world governing body, widely seen as corrupt during his reign.

clue.text: Rotten organisation provided, perversely, not a bloody thing, in short

indicators.note: doing something perversely means doing it the contrary way round, so the word runs backwards

blocks.note: if means provided, as in provided that

blocks.clueFragment: not a bloody thing, in short
blocks.note: FA is short for Fanny Adams, as in sweet FA, meaning nothing at all

explanation.surface: A grumble that a corrupt body provides nothing at all.
explanation.walkthrough: Sweet FA is British slang for nothing; the abbreviation is often read as something ruder.
explanation.definitionFit: FIFA, football's governing body, was mired in bribery scandals, so Private Eye calls it rotten.

clue.text: see 21ac.

explanation.walkthrough: Frolicking seems to describe the sex, but it only rearranges the little word and.

taken as written

clue.text: Public transport on time, say, given backing?  Wise up!

explanation.definitionFit: Telling someone to get smart urges them to become sharper and more aware, which is to wise up.

clue.text: Sixties cool clothes for this punchy show?

clue.text: Dick shown what to do with seedlings
